title: DeepSeek Harness (default)
description: DeepSeek Harness on your project with sandbox-ai's defaults and nothing more: only its model is reachable, everything else is refused or asked; its telemetry is always off.

de.title: DeepSeek Harness (Standard)
de.description: DeepSeek Harness an Ihrem Projekt mit den Voreinstellungen von sandbox-ai und nichts weiter: nur sein Modell ist erreichbar, alles andere wird abgelehnt oder nachgefragt; seine Telemetrie ist immer aus.

notes: The model: DeepSeek's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY once); DeepSeek Harness sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire. A server of yours instead: the preset dsh-local-llm.
Its interactive surface is its web UI on the sandbox's loopback: add --browser to see it in the sandbox's own browser; the terminal has its chat too.
Nothing else is open: package registries, GitHub and every other host are refused or asked (--ask). For more: the preset coding-dsh or sandbox-ai net allow during the run.
Its telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on.
Its image first: sandbox-ai build dsh (a start builds it when it is missing).
